items.text: §17 Quality Gates Before Submission: quality gates are passed before a listing is submitted.
Table header: Gate | Pass Condition.
Identity gate: Brand, product type and seller SKU are coherent.
Quality Gates Before Submission: Identity, Classification, Attributes, Variants, Media, Content, Compliance, Commercial, Submission.
Classification gate: Marketplace category/product type selected.
Classification gate: Marketplace category/product type selected with sufficient confidence.
Attributes gate: All required/conditional attributes are populated.
Attributes gate: required/conditional attributes are populated with valid values.
Variants gate: Every sellable variant has consistent identity.
Variants gate: Every sellable variant has consistent size/color.
Variants gate: Every sellable variant has required identifiers.
Media gate: Required media exists.
Media gate: Required media is associated correctly.
Content gate: Title/bullets/description/keywords are based on verified facts.
Content gate: Title/bullets/description/keywords are based on marketplace rules.
Compliance gate: Required product/packaging declarations are available where applicable.
Compliance gate: Seller information is available where applicable.
Commercial gate: MRP/price and other required commercial fields are internally consistent.
Submission gate: No known blocking validation issue remains.
§18 Apparel Compliance Data to Capture.
§18 is a business-data checklist, not legal advice.
The product should capture the compliance data.
The product should avoid assuming legal compliance merely because fields are populated.
Table header: Compliance Data | Capture At | Notes.
Compliance data "Manufacturer name/address" is captured at: Brand + product.
Manufacturer name/address: exact legal details where applicable.
Compliance data "Marketer/brand owner details" is captured at: Brand/product.
Marketer/brand owner details: captured where applicable.
Compliance data "Importer details" is captured at: Product.
Importer details: for imported products where applicable.
Compliance data "Country of origin/manufacture" is captured at: Product.
Country of origin/manufacture: do not infer from brand location.
Compliance data "Consumer care contact" is captured at: Brand.
Consumer care contact: email/phone as applicable.
Compliance data "Size declaration" is captured at: Variant/product.
Size declaration: international size where required.
Size declaration: metric measurements where required.
Compliance data "MRP inclusive of taxes" is captured at: Variant/product.
MRP inclusive of taxes: capture exact seller-declared MRP.
Compliance data "Fabric/fiber composition" is captured at: Product.
Fabric/fiber composition: capture exact composition rather than generic material wording.
Compliance data "Care instructions" is captured at: Product.
Care instructions: seller/manufacturer-provided.
Compliance data "Package declarations" is captured at: Product/package.
Package declarations: captured where applicable.
Compliance data "HSN/tax classification" is captured at: Variant/product.
HSN/tax classification: seller-provided/verified.
HSN/tax classification: do not blindly infer final tax classification.
Callout title: Legal Metrology Garment Amendment (2022).
India's Department of Consumer Affairs has specific garment-related Legal Metrology requirements.
Legal Metrology Garment Amendment (2022): certain garment/hosiery sales require declarations including manufacturer/marketer/brand owner/importer details.
Legal Metrology 2022 amendment: certain garment/hosiery sales require a consumer-care contact declaration.
Legal Metrology 2022 amendment: certain garment/hosiery sales require a size declaration.
Legal Metrology 2022 amendment: certain garment/hosiery sales require an MRP declaration.
Legal Metrology 2022 amendment: the declared information must be displayed on an e-commerce website.
General packaged-commodity rules also cover a declaration of manufacturer/packer/importer.
General packaged-commodity rules also cover a declaration of country of origin.
General packaged-commodity rules also cover a declaration of generic name.
General packaged-commodity rules also cover a declaration of net quantity.
General packaged-commodity rules also cover a declaration of MRP.
General packaged-commodity rules also cover a declaration of consumer care.
§19 Marketplace-Specific Requirement Matrix.
Use the marketplace-specific requirement matrix as the product design framework.
Exact field names should come from the current marketplace/category schema at the time of listing.
Required/conditional status should come from the current marketplace/category schema at the time of listing.
Table header: Marketplace | Common Apparel Data to Expect | Design Requirement.

Flipkart: preserve seller SKU mapping.

Myntra: do not assume Amazon/Flipkart field names are portable.

Meesho common apparel data to expect: images.

Nykaa Fashion common apparel data to expect: size/color.

Nykaa's seller terms require listing information to be complete.
Nykaa's seller terms require listing information to be accurate.

Callout title: Engineering & Product Invariant.
Invariant: the canonical product model should be broad.
Invariant: marketplace adapters should be narrow.
Never redesign the canonical product every time a marketplace introduces a new field.
§20 Master Field Dictionary defines the Minimum V1 Columns.
The master field dictionary is the recommended spreadsheet-style column set for the initial apparel catalog intake.
The column set can be presented to sellers as a simple template.
The dashboard can hide fields that are not relevant to the selected category.
Table header: Section | Column / Field | Requirement | Business Meaning.
Field seller_sku (section identity): requirement "Yes"; business meaning: Unique seller SKU.
Master Field Dictionary sections: identity, classification, attributes, care, compliance, commercial, media, content, marketplace, workflow.
Field parent_style_id (section identity): requirement "If variants"; business meaning: Style/family identifier.
Field product_name (section identity): requirement "Yes"; business meaning: Seller's factual product/style name.
Field brand_name (section identity): requirement "Yes"; business meaning: Brand.
Field manufacturer_name (section identity): requirement "Usually yes"; business meaning: Manufacturer.
Field manufacturer_address (section identity): requirement "Usually yes"; business meaning: Legal address.
Field product_identifier_type (section identity): requirement "If applicable"; business meaning: GTIN/EAN/UPC etc..
Field product_identifier (section identity): requirement "If applicable"; business meaning: Identifier value.
Field gender (section classification): requirement "Category dependent"; business meaning: Men/Women/Unisex/Boys/Girls.
Field category (section classification): requirement "Yes"; business meaning: Canonical category.
Field sub_category (section classification): requirement "Yes"; business meaning: Canonical sub-category.
Field product_type (section classification): requirement "Yes"; business meaning: Specific product type.
Field color_name (section attributes): requirement "Yes"; business meaning: Seller color.
Field normalized_color (section attributes): requirement "System"; business meaning: Normalized value.
Field size_name (section attributes): requirement "Yes for sized apparel"; business meaning: Seller size.
Field normalized_size (section attributes): requirement "System"; business meaning: Normalized value.
Field size_system (section attributes): requirement "If applicable"; business meaning: Brand/marketplace size system.
Field fit (section attributes): requirement "Category dependent"; business meaning: Slim/regular/relaxed etc..
Field pattern (section attributes): requirement "Category dependent"; business meaning: Solid/printed/etc..
Field fabric_type (section attributes): requirement "Usually yes"; business meaning: Cotton/denim/linen etc..
Field fiber_composition (section attributes): requirement "Critical"; business meaning: Exact composition where available.
Field lining (section attributes): requirement "If applicable"; business meaning: Lined/unlined + material.
Field stretch (section attributes): requirement "If applicable"; business meaning: Stretch/non-stretch.
Field neckline (section attributes): requirement "If applicable"; business meaning: Crew/V/etc..
Field collar_type (section attributes): requirement "If applicable"; business meaning: Collar.
Field sleeve_type (section attributes): requirement "If applicable"; business meaning: Sleeve.
Field sleeve_length (section attributes): requirement "If applicable"; business meaning: Sleeve length.
Field garment_length (section attributes): requirement "If applicable"; business meaning: Length.
Field rise (section attributes): requirement "Bottomwear"; business meaning: High/mid/low.
Field leg_style (section attributes): requirement "Bottomwear"; business meaning: Straight/wide/tapered etc..
Field closure (section attributes): requirement "If applicable"; business meaning: Zip/button/pull-on.
Field pocket_type (section attributes): requirement "If applicable"; business meaning: Pocket details.
Field occasion (section attributes): requirement "If applicable"; business meaning: Casual/formal/etc..
Field season (section attributes): requirement "If applicable"; business meaning: Seasonality.
Field wash_care (section care): requirement "Usually yes"; business meaning: Care instructions.
Field iron_care (section care): requirement "If applicable"; business meaning: Ironing instructions.
Field country_of_origin (section compliance): requirement "Yes where applicable"; business meaning: Origin.
Field mrp (section compliance): requirement "Yes"; business meaning: MRP inclusive of taxes where applicable.
Field consumer_care_email (section compliance): requirement "Yes where applicable"; business meaning: Consumer care.
Field consumer_care_phone (section compliance): requirement "Yes where applicable"; business meaning: Consumer care.
Field hsn_code (section compliance): requirement "Marketplace dependent"; business meaning: Seller-provided/verified.
Field selling_price (section commercial): requirement "Marketplace dependent"; business meaning: Selling price.
Field tax_rate (section commercial): requirement "Marketplace dependent"; business meaning: Seller-provided/verified.
Field package_weight (section commercial): requirement "If required"; business meaning: Packed weight.
Field package_length_cm (section commercial): requirement "If required"; business meaning: Package length.
Field package_breadth_cm (section commercial): requirement "If required"; business meaning: Package breadth.
Field package_height_cm (section commercial): requirement "If required"; business meaning: Package height.
Field main_image (section media): requirement "Yes"; business meaning: Main image.
Field additional_images (section media): requirement "As available"; business meaning: Additional images.
Field size_chart (section media): requirement "If applicable"; business meaning: Size chart.
Field title (section content): requirement "System/generated + editable"; business meaning: Marketplace title.
Field bullet_1_to_n (section content): requirement "System-generated"; business meaning: Key features.
Field description (section content): requirement "System-generated"; business meaning: Description.
Field keywords (section content): requirement "System-generated"; business meaning: Search terms where supported.
Field marketplace_category (section marketplace): requirement "Per marketplace"; business meaning: Mapped category.
Field marketplace_product_type (section marketplace): requirement "Per marketplace"; business meaning: Mapped product type.
Field marketplace_sku (section marketplace): requirement "Per marketplace"; business meaning: External/seller marketplace SKU.
Field marketplace_listing_id (section marketplace): requirement "Per marketplace"; business meaning: External listing ID.
Field marketplace_status (section marketplace): requirement "Per marketplace"; business meaning: Current state.
Field live_url (section marketplace): requirement "Per marketplace"; business meaning: Live URL if available.
Field overall_status (section workflow): requirement "System"; business meaning: Current overall status.
Field open_issue_count (section workflow): requirement "System"; business meaning: Open issues.
Field human_action_required (section workflow): requirement "System"; business meaning: Yes/No.
Field last_updated (section workflow): requirement "System"; business meaning: Timestamp.
§21 Example: One Apparel Product Through the System.
Callout title: Product Specification Case Study.
Example product: Women's relaxed-fit cotton T-shirt.
Example product color: Black.
Example product sizes: S/M/L/XL.
Example product seller SKU: FSH-TEE-001.
Table header: Stage | What Happens.
Intake stage: seller provides SKU.
Intake stage: seller provides product images.
Intake stage: seller provides product name.
Intake stage: seller provides brand.
Intake stage: seller provides fabric composition.
Intake stage: seller provides colors.
Intake stage: seller provides sizes.
Intake stage: seller provides MRP.
Intake stage: seller provides care instructions.
Intake stage: seller provides size chart.
Example stage sequence, in order: Intake, Understand, Classify, Extract, Canonical, Generate, Validate, Human, Submit, Error, Resubmit, Live, Dashboard.
Understand stage: agent identifies a women's T-shirt.
Understand stage: agent identifies black color.
Understand stage: agent identifies relaxed fit.
Understand stage: agent identifies cotton composition.
Understand stage: agent identifies four sizes.
Classify stage: agent maps the product to the appropriate apparel/T-shirt category for each selected marketplace.
Extract stage: agent normalizes 'Jet Black' to the marketplace's accepted black value where appropriate.
Extract stage: normalization preserves the seller value.
Canonical stage: one product record contains identity.
Canonical stage: one product record contains attributes.
Canonical stage: one product record contains variants.
Canonical stage: one product record contains media.
Canonical stage: one product record contains compliance.
Canonical stage: one product record contains content.
Generate stage: agent creates title.
Generate stage: agent creates bullets.
Generate stage: agent creates description.
Generate stage: agent creates relevant keywords.
Generate stage: content is created using only verified facts.
Validate stage: checks all marketplace-specific mandatory/conditional fields.
Validate stage: checks variant/media rules.
Human stage: if a marketplace requires a missing fabric detail, the agent asks one targeted question.
Submit stage: agent submits the marketplace-specific representation.
Error stage example: marketplace rejects one size because the size value is invalid.
Error stage: agent maps the canonical size to the accepted marketplace value.
Error stage: agent revalidates after mapping.
Resubmit stage: corrected listing is submitted.
Live stage: marketplace confirms the listing active.
Live stage: Listing ID is stored.
Live stage: listing URL is stored.
Dashboard stage: product shows LIVE for that marketplace.
Dashboard stage: separate statuses shown for any other marketplaces still processing.
